name: smwgraphics-plumber-s-factory
title: Plumber's Factory
description:
An original interior factory background with two styles:
-Main Floor BG
-Base Floor BG
These include 8 alternate pallete variants for the factory scheme (Mario (Red/Gray), Luigi (Green/Blue), Wario (Orange/Purple), Waluigi (Blue/Yellow), Peach (Pink/Magenta), Daisy (Orange/Bronze), Rosalina (Light Blue, Tosca Green), and Pauline (Pink Rose/Black)).
